item.title: The Cold Email
item.description:
📝 GitHub at the time was kind of the most clique-y of startups; they had made it clear that practically all hires at that point they had worked with previously or interacted through open source. But the difference is I’m also going to tell you all of the cold emails I’ve written that when nowhere and didn’t end up changing my life. Same with cold pitches to my profile on Signed: I’ve invested in many startups that I hadn’t the faintest connection to personally.
🔗 Read more: https://zachholman.com/posts/cold-email
